```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

clean = pd.read_csv("../data/processed/retail_sales_index_clean.csv", parse_dates=["period"])
summary = pd.read_csv("../outputs/tables/headline_summary.csv").iloc[0]

latest_period = str(summary["latest_period"])
latest_value = f"{float(summary['latest_value']):.1f}"
previous_period = str(summary["previous_period"])
direction = str(summary["direction"])
month_on_month_change = f"{float(summary['month_on_month_change']):.1f}"
year_on_year_change = f"{float(summary['year_on_year_change']):.1f}"
dataset_title = str(summary["dataset_title"])
dataset_version = str(int(summary["dataset_version"]))
release_date = str(summary["release_date"])
retrieved_at_utc = str(summary["retrieved_at_utc"])
source_url = str(summary["source_url"])
```

# Retail Sales Index

Latest headline value and recent movement in the Retail Sales Index, 2019 = 100.
:::

::: {.metric-grid}
```{python}
#| output: asis
print(f"""
<div class="metric">
  <div class="label">Latest period</div>
  <div class="value">{latest_period}</div>
</div>
<div class="metric">
  <div class="label">Index value</div>
  <div class="value">{latest_value}</div>
  <div class="small">2019 = 100</div>
</div>
<div class="metric">
  <div class="label">Monthly change</div>
  <div class="value">{month_on_month_change}</div>
  <div class="small">index points from {previous_period}</div>
</div>
<div class="metric">
  <div class="label">Annual change</div>
  <div class="value">{year_on_year_change}</div>
  <div class="small">index points year on year</div>
</div>
""")
```
:::

The latest available Retail Sales Index value for **`{python} latest_period`** was **`{python} latest_value`** on a 2019 = 100 basis.

Compared with **`{python} previous_period`**, the index **`{python} direction`** by **`{python} month_on_month_change` index points**. Compared with the same month one year earlier, the index changed by **`{python} year_on_year_change` index points**.

## Key statistics

```{python}
display_cols = [
    "latest_period",
    "latest_value",
    "month_on_month_change",
    "year_on_year_change",
    "observations",
]
pd.DataFrame([summary[display_cols]]).rename(
    columns={
        "latest_period": "Latest period",
        "latest_value": "Index value",
        "month_on_month_change": "Monthly change",
        "year_on_year_change": "Annual change",
        "observations": "Observations",
    }
)
```

## Source and method

::: {.source-note}
Dataset: `{python} dataset_title`<br>
Version: `{python} dataset_version`<br>
Release date: `{python} release_date`<br>
Data retrieved: `{python} retrieved_at_utc`<br>
Source CSV: `{python} source_url`
:::

This report is generated by a reproducible analytical pipeline using the public ONS API.

The pipeline downloads the raw CSV, filters to the headline Great Britain all-retailing volume series, calculates change over time, produces a chart, and renders this statistical summary.
